features.name: Nature Magic
features.description:
At 1st level, when your Spellcasting feature lets you learn or replace a sorcerer cantrip or spell, you can choose from the druid spell list instead. It becomes a sorcerer spell for you.

At 5th level, you can cast *speak with plants* without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. Regain all uses on long rest.

features.name: Spore Transmission
features.description: At 1st level, as a bonus action, create a telepathic spore link with one creature within 30 ft you can see. You can speak telepathically; it can respond if it knows a language. Lasts 10 minutes or until you use a bonus action to break it or link to a different creature. Unwilling targets can CHA save at end of each turn to end the link (immune for 24 hrs if successful).

payload.name: Spore Transmission
payload.description: Create a telepathic spore link with a creature within 30 ft for 10 min. Unwilling targets may CHA save each turn.

features.name: Metamagic Spore Transmission
features.description:
Starting at 6th level, your Metamagic effects are enhanced on the Spore Transmission target:

**Careful Spell.** Linked target takes no damage on a successful save (instead of half).
**Distant Spell.** Touch spells have 60 ft range on linked target.
**Extended Spell.** Duration tripled (not doubled, max 36 hours) on linked target.
**Hungry Spell.** If linked target drops to 0 HP, regain HP equal to 2× CHA mod.
**Lingering Spell.** Linked target has disadvantage on the follow-up save.
**Shared Hunger Spell.** Both you and target regain HP equal to 2× CHA mod if it hits.
**Twinned Spell.** Spend 1 additional sorcery point to affect linked target as a third target.

features.name: Spore's Protection
features.description: Starting at 14th level, when an attacker you can see targets you with a melee attack, use your reaction to cloud its senses. It has disadvantage on the attack roll. If it hits, you gain 10 temporary HP (lasts 1 min).

payload.name: Spore's Protection
payload.description: Incoming melee attack: attacker has disadvantage. If it still hits, gain 10 temp HP for 1 min.

features.name: Spore Form
features.description: At 18th level, you gain immunity to poison damage and the poisoned condition. As an action, radiate spores in a 20-ft radius for 1 minute: friendly creatures starting a turn there regain CHA modifier HP; hostile creatures take CHA modifier poison damage. Spore Transmission target regains or takes double. 1/long rest.

payload.name: Spore Form
payload.description: Radiate spores 20-ft radius for 1 min: allies regain CHA mod HP; enemies take CHA mod poison. Linked target gets double.
